settings.name: Pick Your AI — Funding, Grants & Sustainability
settings.description: Community-led research, nonprofit readiness, grant discovery, financial sponsorship, donated infrastructure, inference credits, hardware, development tools, technical assistance, and sustainable funding for Pick Your AI.
settings.readme:
# Funding, Grants & Sustainability

Canonical program repository: https://github.com/Pick-Your-AI/pick-your-ai-sustainability

Track immediate open-source support, fiscal-sponsorship pathways, and future independent nonprofit readiness. Pick Your AI intends to pursue US 501(c)(3) status; incorporation, IRS recognition and program-specific eligibility are separate gates.

Research completion does not mean an application was submitted or support obtained. Applications, outreach, benefit activation, agreements, financial accounts and legal filings require recorded authorization. Sponsor support must not buy research conclusions, rankings, compatibility results, or exclusion of competitors.

Use the repository README, opportunity register, source dates and issue acceptance criteria. GitHub Assignees remain authoritative; no owner commitments are assumed. Existing technical, market, website, mobile and leaderboard work stays in its canonical Projects 1–6.
